Untrusted instructions can therefore enter durable memory and return as trusted instructions in later sessions, rather than merely being re-fetched from the manifest (agent-sec-lab/agent/memory.py:1-7; agent-sec-lab/agent/memory.py:72-79).",

Ordinary model/tool iteration does not establish those missing structural facts (agent-sec-lab/agent/loop.py:43-56).",
    "ES": "Remote manifests are dynamically re-fetched and trusted, and attacker-selected names can replace both model-visible built-ins and their dispatch bindings (agent-sec-lab/agent/mcp_client.py:1-4; agent-sec-lab/agent/loop.py:35-37; agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:226-229). This is an independently unconstrained remote extension surface.",
    "CVSS": "The documented internal-only lab network supports AV:A; the optional MCP attachment is an external configuration prerequisite, while unpinned loading requires neither agent privileges nor defeating a defense, and ordinary emailing supplies passive interaction (agent-sec-lab/docker-compose.yml:1-3; agent-sec-lab/agent/loop.py:28-38; agent-sec-lab/agent/mcp_client.py:1-4). The documented interception establishes limited email disclosure, corrupted tool dispatch, and interruption of the built-in email function, without demonstrating whole-agent compromise or disclosure of specifically high-value information (agent-sec-lab/docs/writeups/s4-mcp-rug-pull.md:8-15; agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:226-229).
